# Icon provenance

The 229 icons in this folder are the design's exact path data: 145 from `ICON_PATHS` in `design/_ds/ferman-design-system-27832349-21bc-410e-acd5-6ab20d2f87e2/_ds_bundle.js` and 84 from `design/ds-additions/fm-icons.js`, which the design merges into `ICON_PATHS` at run time. Each file wraps the design's child elements, byte for byte, in a 24 × 24 SVG drawn with a 1.5 px `currentColor` stroke and round caps and joins, as the design system draws its icons (ADR 0013, G04, G60). The app does not load these files: it paints the same elements from `app/lib/design/icons/icon_data.g.dart`, which tools/icons generates from the same source.

## Licences

Lucide is licensed under ISC. Portions of Lucide derive from Feather and are licensed under MIT (Cole Bemis). The licence files below are the `package/LICENSE` files of the lucide-static npm releases, copied verbatim:

- `LICENSE-lucide-0.460.0.txt`: lucide-static 0.460.0, byte-identical to 0.500.0, 0.300.0.
- `LICENSE-lucide-1.56.0.txt`: lucide-static 1.56.0.

The newest file lists the Feather-derived icons and carries the MIT text. The one glyph that matches no Lucide release is drawn for Ferman and is covered by the project licence; it stays pending until the design re-export settles it (Q11).

## How the source is found

Each icon is compared with the file of the same name in the pinned lucide-static releases 0.460.0, 1.56.0, 0.500.0, 0.300.0 (npm tarballs verified by their integrity hashes). Two drawings match when they have the same elements in the same order with the same attributes; attribute order and whitespace do not count. The first matching release in that order is the source. `tools/icons/lucide_matches.json` records the matches with the SHA-256 of each glyph, and a run without the tarballs stops when a glyph has changed since. "Mirrors in RTL" marks the icons the design flips in right-to-left layouts.
